UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Represents a user's profile and prakriti analysis results.

id.description: Unique identifier for the user profile, same as the Firebase Auth UID.

vataScore.description: User's Vata score from the Prakriti Analyzer.

pittaScore.description: User's Pitta score from the Prakriti Analyzer.

kaphaScore.description: User's Kapha score from the Prakriti Analyzer.

dominantDosha.description: The user's dosha constitution based on the Prakriti analysis (e.g., Vata, Pitta-Kapha).

favoritePlantIds.description: An array of plant IDs that the user has favorited.

gardenPlantIds.description: An array of plant IDs that the user has added to their garden plan.

Plant.title: Plant
Plant.description: Represents a medicinal plant with its properties and uses.

description.description: A brief description of the plant.

uses.description: Traditional and medicinal uses of the plant.

hint.description: Hint for AI image generation or search.

definition.description: Stores user profile data, including Prakriti analysis results and favorite plants. Uses path-based ownership for straightforward security rules.

params.name: userId
params.description: The unique identifier of the user, matching their Firebase Auth UID.

definition.description: Stores plant data for the digital herbarium. This data is public and read-only for clients.

params.name: plantId
params.description: The unique identifier of the plant.
